title: A new companion to the Romance languages
summary: This companion offers a balanced overview of the core subjects of Romance linguistics. It provides a basic canon as well as access to specialised areas of research by means of references to the latest handbooks and encyclopedias. It is designed to be read from cover to cover or to be consulted on specific topics. This accessible and up-to-date reference work enables readers to contextualise any knowledge of the field they may already possess.
